project.name: universal-ai-context-layer-demo
project.summary: A vendor-neutral context layer that preserves project knowledge across AI models, tools, and agents.

project_goals: Keep architecture decisions available across Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini.
Give specialized agents one shared source of truth.
current_tasks: Validate UACL context handoffs with multiple AI tools.

decisions.title: Canonical YAML context
decisions.rationale: YAML is readable, editable, and version-control friendly.

constraints: Do not send repository content to remote services automatically.
known_issues: Concurrent agent updates are not automatically merged.
ai_instructions: Read the complete UACL context before proposing changes.

agent_roles.name: Coordinator Agent
agent_roles.responsibility: Maintains priorities and delegates scoped work.

agent_roles.name: Coding Agent
agent_roles.responsibility: Implements current tasks within recorded constraints.

agent_roles.name: Reviewer Agent
agent_roles.responsibility: Validates changes against goals and decisions.
